Messages.Author: GymNat1
Messages.Body:
Now we all know that a titled Camarilla vampire loses his title when he is
deranged, but what about a previously called Archon on said vampire. do the
Archon abilities go away when he is deranged?

Nat

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No.
The vampire is an archon once the referendum succeeds. Card text makes
no indication of continually checking the sect of the target.
